description: Reverse-engineer any video, shot by shot: filmed, AI-generated or coded, and how to remake it. Breakdowns in the open VIDEO.md format. 逆向一切视频，逐个镜头看是拍的、AI 生成的还是代码做的，再告诉你怎么复刻；拆解结果按 VIDEO.md 格式输出。

latest_release.body:
## 视频拆解标准包 Reel，报告重写，音效单独分离

这一版定下了视频拆解的标准包格式：拆片包（Reel）。拆一条视频现在得到两样东西：给人看的报告（HTML / PDF），和给模型、下游项目读的拆片包。格式介绍和规范见 [docs/reel.md](https://github.com/JuneYaooo/rea-video/blob/v0.1.0/docs/reel.md)。

**拆片包 Reel**
- 四层逐级展开：卡片 → 概览和地图 → 时间线（一行一镜）→ 单镜文件，最后才是完整数据。一条 3 分钟口播读到概览约 2k token，完整数据约 19 万 token。
- 每个文件开头写着自己的 token 数；看到的和推断的分开写，时间线里推断的键名带 `~`。
- 字段有 JSON Schema（`rea_video/reel.schema.json`）。`rea-video reel out/ref --check` 检查一个目录是否合格，`reel.read()` 读出结构化数据。
- 拆解时自动生成；旧的输出目录用 `rea-video reel out/ref` 补出来。

**给人看的报告**
- 从上往下：一句话结论 → 核心看点（开头怎么抓人、能火的几处做法，写明第几秒）→ 画面 / 包装 / 声音三层 → 叙事线 → 分镜表 → 照着复刻的步骤和每步细节 → 参考细节。每样信息只出现一次。
- 分镜表每镜分「画面里看得到的」和「工具推断的制作方式」。
- 判断依据写明是谁看的：工具测量、看图模型、AI 助手看图复核、用户纠正。
- `rea-video pdf out/ref` 用本机 Chrome 打印成 PDF；正文折叠内容展开，时间轴、逐镜取证这类查阅数据保持折叠。

**复刻方案**
- 每个 AI 生成单元写明要喂什么：首帧、尾帧、参考图、参考视频，各自从哪来、为什么要。首尾帧和参考素材不能放进同一个请求的模型（如 Seedance 2.x），每个单元只选一种：要保住商品和人物长相时用参考图，只锁构图时用首尾帧。
- Seedance 2.0 的能力补全：一次能出多个镜头，参考图 9 张、参考视频和音频各 3 段，时长 4–15 秒。默认按它规划，不再换成 2.5。能力地图新增 `exclusive_inputs` 字段。
- 同一段成片在片中用了两次（开头先放预告、结尾完整放）时，只生成一次，剪辑时放到两处。
- 拍摄场次和生成单元优先按看图认出的场景分组，特写和中景不会因为颜色不同被拆开。

**声音**
- 音效单独分离：新增对白 / 音乐 / 音效三轨分离（BandIt v2），音效从音效轨上找，不再在混音里找突然变响的点，人声的爆破音和配乐的鼓点不会再算成音效。在混了 12 个已知音效的 60 秒口播上，找到的从 1 个变成 8 个。
- 听起来一样的音效合并成一种，写明用了几次、在哪几秒；每种能直接试听，试听片段听不到人声和配乐。
- 只列卡在字幕、贴纸、切镜上的后期音效；画面自带的环境声、动作声不算。

**判断**
- 只有 AI 助手看图复核、没有看图模型时，复核的判断可以跳出工具的前两名（融合结果要正是复核选的类别，且这一镜没有 24→30 这类帧率证据）。相机拍真实手机屏幕的画面不会再停在「3D / 代码渲染」。
- 30fps 文件里每隔一帧重复，不再当成 24fps 素材的证据（那是画面几乎不动）。
- 复核时列出每镜后期加的字幕，画面里拍到的手机界面、包装上的字不再算成字幕和标注。
- 看图复核新增三项：核心看点（`story`）、每镜后期文字（`overlay_text`）、重复使用的成片（`same_clip_as`）。

**评测**
- 评测摘要新增 `by_resolution` / `by_camera`，按分辨率和运镜拆开准确率和误判方向。
- `eval/RESULTS.md` 新增「只用 agent 复核」一栏、误判分布，以及全部评测集从头解码重测的结果。只用工具时，文章视频 88.6% → 96.5%，带货 46.4% → 63.2%，口播 75.5% → 93.3%，没有一组下降。

## 剪辑包装跟着台词走

口播、带货这类片子，画面里的字幕、花字、贴纸大多跟着说的话出现。这一版把包装层和台词对上，复刻时生成模型只出干净的画面，包装层后叠。

**拆解**
- 按台词定位：花字、标题、贴纸落在哪句字幕上，句中第几秒，有没有重复句里的词（「五折」花字落在「全场五折」这句上）。换文案时按句子放，不按原秒数。只认说话那一条字幕；画面里的字、OCR 杂讯不参与。
- 常驻图层：跨切镜不变的免责声明、标题栏、角标单独列出，同一段文字多次出现合成一个，复刻时整段叠一次。
- 竖排小字导出 ASS 时按竖排输出，字号不超过测得的文字框。

**复刻**
- `remake-plan`：首尾帧上带着原片字幕、花字或贴纸的镜头，任务里标出 `overlays_in_frames` 并提醒先擦掉再生成，`--dry-run` 会打印出来。
- 复刻方案里，生成单元镜头上有包装层时多一条说明：包装层不写进提示词，生成后叠回。
- `assemble --overlays`：把测得的字幕、花字、标题按原样式叠到换掉的镜头上，原片占位的镜头不重复叠；贴纸列在 `assemble_log.json` 里。

## 切点检测

剪辑节奏复刻靠切点。切点漏了，镜头时长、卡点、复刻时间轴都会跟着偏。这一版重写了切点判断，复刻时生成片段按整段变速对齐原镜头。

**切点**
- 跳剪 / 推近切：同机位、同背景，人物位置或景别在一帧内跳变，变化面积小，以前抓不到。现在看这一帧的变化是否远高于前后几帧，并确认前后都平稳、画面没有回到切之前。口播和手持开箱里大量这种切点。
- 闪光、枪口火光、频闪：一两帧内变亮又恢复原样，不算切点。闪白转场褪去后露出新画面，仍算切点。
- 挨得很近的几处边界（闪光紧挨着真切点、一帧残影、甩镜）只保留最强的一处，不再只认第一处。
- 两刀干净硬切之间画面稳定的短镜头，最短保留 0.12 秒（快剪里的插入镜头、开头封面帧），以前不到 0.35 秒都会被并掉。
- 短镜头里只出现一帧重复，不再当作 24fps 转制的证据，短实拍镜头不会因此被判成 AI。

**复刻**
- `assemble` 把生成片段整段变速塞进原镜头时长（最多快 3 倍、慢 1.25 倍，超出部分再裁）。生成模型有最短时长，以前只截前几秒，动作做一半就切走，节奏偏慢。

**评测**
- `eval/koubo.yaml`、`daihuo.yaml`、`film.yaml`、`articles.yaml` 给 9 条片子加了逐帧人工标注的切点真值（`cuts`），看不准的位置放在 `cuts_uncertain`，检测到也不算错。评测输出新增切点汇总（找到 / 漏掉 / 误报）。

| 评测集 | 切点召回 | 切点精确率 |
|---|---|---|
| 口播（2 条） | 71% → 91% | 89% → 90% |
| 带货（2 条） | 44% → 94% | 79% → 87% |
| 影视混剪（4 条） | 93% → 98% | 93% → 98% |
| 手机实拍带货（1 条） | 83% → 92% | 100% → 100% |
| 合计 | 79% → 95% | 91% → 94% |

制作方式准确率在本地还找得到的部分样本上（不是全集）：labels / holdout / holdout2 为 100% → 99.2% / 99.5% → 99.7% / 100% → 100%。全集的数字见 `eval/RESULTS.md`。

**速度和消耗**

切得更细以后镜头变多（评测集整体 +14%），这一版同时把逐镜的开销压下来，拆解时间和 VLM 调用次数都没有因此上涨：
- 镜头上的文字直接取剪辑包装层整片 OCR 那一遍的结果，不再每个镜头另读 4 帧；整片 OCR 太稀（长视频）或关掉包装层时，按镜头时长读 1–4 帧。
- 全分辨率首尾帧（复刻的首帧参考）在后台抽取，和下一个镜头的计算并行。
- 跳剪连起来的几段是同一条素材剪开的，报告里标为「跳剪」。开 VLM 时合成一个片段问一次（最长 12 秒、最多 8 段）：制作方式和拍法整段给一次，每段的内容描述和复刻提示词分开给。复刻计划里这几段照常合成同一个生成单元。
- VLM 调用次数到上限（60 次）时，优先给工具最拿不准、时长最长的镜头，不再只取前 60 个。

| 片子（不开 VLM） | 切点优化前 | 切点优化后 | 提速后 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 72 秒开箱 | 29 镜 100 秒 | 68 镜 173 秒 | 68 镜 104 秒 |
| 166 秒口播 | 62 镜 224 秒 | 69 镜 229 秒 | 69 镜 206 秒 |

镜头的制作方式判断、真实素材判断和字幕时间轴与提速前一致（全部评测集逐条对比）。开 VLM 时：开箱片 68 个镜头只需 24 次调用（按镜头调要到 60 次上限，最后 8 个镜头拿不到 VLM）；夜景口播 69 个镜头 57 次，全部镜头都有 VLM 结果。

**已知局限**
- 手机录屏里的界面滑动、翻页动画仍会被当成切点。
- 切得更细后，暗光口播叠截图、3D 毛绒角色的短镜头有时会判错制作方式。

detail.readme:
Reverse-engineer any video. Shot by shot: was it filmed, AI-generated or coded, and how to remake it. Every breakdown is written in **[VIDEO.md](https://videomd.github.io/videomd/)**, an open format that agents read layer by layer. [Website](https://www.reavideo.ai) | [中文](i18n/README_zh.md) | English | [Русский](i18n/README_ru.md) | [日本語](i18n/README_ja.md) | [한국어](i18n/README_ko.md) | [Español](i18n/README_es.md) | [Português](i18n/README_pt.md) | [Français](i18n/README_fr.md) | [Deutsch](i18n/README_de.md) | [Tiếng Việt](i18n/README_vi.md) | [বাংলা](i18n/README_bn.md) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/JuneYaooo/rea-video?style=flat)](https://github.com/JuneYaooo/rea-video/stargazers) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-%E2%89%A53.10-blue) ![Agent](https://img.shields.io/badge/runs%20in-Claude%20Code%20%7C%20Codex-8A2BE2) [![Output: VIDEO.md](https://img.shields.io/badge/output-VIDEO.md-3d4fd6)](https://videomd.github.io/videomd/) [![Visit our website](https://img.shields.io/badge/Visit%20our%20website-6644D8?style=for-the-badge)](https://www.reavideo.ai) [![Join our Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Join%20our%20Discord-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/dZj8D3GqWT) [![WeChat group](https://img.shields.io/badge/WeChat%20group-07C160?style=for-the-badge&logo=wechat&logoColor=white)](i18n/README_zh.md#社区) [![Follow on X](https://img.shields.io/badge/Follow%20%40yao__june12106-000000?style=for-the-badge&logo=x&logoColor=white)](https://x.com/yao_june12106) ⭐ *Help more people find rea-video. Star this repo!* Left: a TikTok ad shot on a phone. Right: an AI remake with another product. rea-video's verdict: the left is all live footage, one set and two camera positions; the right is all AI, 8 shots across 3 generations.
## Quick start rea-video is built for AI agents. In Claude Code, Codex or any agent that can run commands, say: ```text Install https://github.com/JuneYaooo/rea-video, then break down this video: /path/to/video.mp4 ``` The agent installs the CLI, learns the workflow and runs the whole thing. You need ffmpeg and Python 3.10+. Breakdowns are fully upgraded. Each one gives you two outputs: - **Report** (`report.html` / PDF), for you: more reader-friendly, with a clearer structure, easier to learn from and to understand how the video was made and how to remake it. - **[VIDEO.md](https://videomd.github.io/videomd/)**, for your AI: layered, so the AI reads only what a question needs and uses fewer tokens. You can also hook up a video-capable model (Gemini or Doubao both work) by giving the agent its endpoint and key. That makes the live/AI/3D calls more accurate and adds a reverse-engineered prompt for every shot. It works fine without one; if your agent can see images, it checks the uncertain shots itself. > Reports are written in whichever language you ask in (Chinese or English). The example reports below are in English. ## What it can break down | Video type | Examples | What you get | |---|---|---| | Live footage | Talking-head, tabletop, handheld product demo, vlog, store visit | Setups and camera positions, framing, camera moves, lighting (12 setups with gear lists), color grade | | AI video | Text/image-to-video, AI short drama, AI music video | Evidence, a reverse-engineered prompt per shot, how to batch into generations and which model to use | | Avatar | A portrait driven by audio, lip-sync | Which shots are avatar shots, what portrait and audio you need | | 3D / animation | Blender / C4D explainers, product animation, 2D animation, stop-motion | Whether to generate with a video model or render from 3D code | | Code / template | Kinetic type, UI demos, charts, slide-style cards | Text, layout and motion timing, ready to rebuild as a Remotion project | | Screen recording | Software tutorials, web demos | Which parts are real material you'll need to record yourself | | Mixed / edits | AI characters + code UI + real screen capture; live footage with AI edits | Each shot judged separately, then reassembled on the original timeline | Besides how the visuals were made, every breakdown also covers: - Captions and styled text: start and end of each line (exports to SRT / ASS), plus color, outline and how the text comes in - Stickers, emoji, picture-in-picture: where they sit and how long they stay - Editing: where the cuts are, how fast, whether they hit the beat - Audio: human or AI voice, AI or library music and its BPM, where each sound effect lands - Material you'll need to supply yourself: screen recordings, screenshots, product photos ## Examples The sample videos in `docs/cases/videos/` are re-compressed to keep the repo small, which strips the TikTok / Douyin platform tags. So if you run them yourself, you'll get different results from the reports below, especially without a vision model. To reproduce them, use the original downloads from the platform.

Mixed-media clip · 19 s · 10 shots
AI characters talking + code-built UI + 8 s of real screen recording. The 5 dialogue shots are broken up by UI segments but share one set, so a single generation covers all of them.
Video · Report
3D explainer · 67 s · 21 shots
All 3D, AI narration. You can do it in 10 video generations, or have an LLM write Blender / Three.js code.
Video · Report

Product promo · 70 s · 12 shots
83% code-driven motion graphics, 12% screen recording. No video model needed; one Remotion project does it.
Video · Report
AI music video · 165 s · 86 shots
Correctly flags the song as AI-generated (it was made with Suno). The vision model called some shots "live-action drama"; the agent spotted fake Chinese characters on a scroll and ruled them AI.
Video · Report

Live-action unboxing · 72 s · 29 shots
All real footage: an overhead phone rig, one rug, one camera position, no voice-over, room sound plus library BGM. After platform transcoding, the offline tools called 35% of it AI; after agent review it came out 97% live-action.
Video · Report
## Remakes After rea-video breaks a video down, the remake recipe in [capsule-cinema](https://github.com/JuneYaooo/capsule-cinema) generates a new version that keeps the original's camera, motion, pacing and transitions and swaps only the elements you pick. These were made with a self-hosted MiniMax H3, using the original shot as the motion reference and keyframes with the swapped elements (gpt-image-2) for the look. Below are three remakes OiiOii showed in its WeChat articles. We made two versions of each: one with the same swap as OiiOii, and one that also swaps the subject, setting and props. Each GIF plays four versions in sync: the original, OiiOii's remake, our remake and the element-swap version.
Overhead outfit change · 12 s
Same swap: woman → man, three outfits → matching menswear. Element swap: a girl in three historical Hanfu outfits in a Chinese study; the remote becomes a round fan.

HD comparison video (with audio) · same-moment stills
Paper-craft / watercolor animation · 30 s
Same swap: new clay girl as the lead. Element swap: a fox; forest → coral reef, clouds → starry sky, sunset → aurora.

HD comparison video (with audio) · same-moment stills
Handheld product video · 21 s · 11 shots
Same swap: an original new product, English sticker → Chinese caption. Element swap: pink product, kitchen → camping table, new ingredients.

HD comparison video (with audio) · same-moment stills
The HD comparison videos use the original audio. The originals and OiiOii versions come from the articles and are shown for comparison only. You can also do the remake in [ChatCut](https://chatcut.io/r/github-e4rd), a hosted AI video editor: there is no model to set up, and the generated shots land on a timeline you can keep editing. Sponsor ## Sponsors rea-video is free and open source. Sponsors help keep it maintained.
ChatCut is an AI video editor for Claude Code and Codex that generates the shots, cuts them on a timeline and exports the finished video.
Try ChatCut for free
Sponsored · Become a sponsor ## Accuracy Accuracy of the how-it-was-made call, weighted by shot duration: | | Tuning set (15) | Holdout (16) | Re-encoded WeChat videos (10) | |---|---|---|---| | Tools only (offline, free) | 98.3% | 99.6% / 98.9% | 88.6% | | + vision model (Gemini) | — | 99.6% / 99.8% | 99.6% | | + agent visual review | — | 99.6% / 99.8% | 100% | The Holdout column shows two numbers: holdout (9 videos) and holdout2 (7 videos). On original files, the tools alone are usually enough. Videos downloaded from platforms have been recompressed, which wipes out the noise evidence, so you need a visual check to get back above 99%. Real-asset detection is 97–99%; on nine hand-labelled clips, shot boundaries reach 95% recall and 94% precision. Numbers and how to reproduce them: [eval/RESULTS.md](eval/RESULTS.md). ## How it works ![rea-video pipeline](docs/rea-flow_en.svg) 1. Split: cut the video into shots and split the audio into voice, music and effects. 2. Gather evidence: measure (frame cadence, sensor noise, whether the whole image moves as one flat plane, AIGC tags in the metadata), look (hands, text, physics) and listen (BPM, key, singing vs speech). 3. Decide: hard evidence like AIGC tags and frame cadence beats "looks like". Conflicts get flagged for the agent to check visually. 4. Plan the remake: batch shots according to what the target video model can actually do, such as max clip length, multi-shot support and how many reference images it takes. ## Star History [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/svg?repos=JuneYaooo/rea-video&type=Date)](https://star-history.com/#JuneYaooo/rea-video&Date) ## FAQ
How is this different from one-click remake tools like Hypit? [Hypit](https://github.com/hypit-ai/hypit) takes a reference video and makes a new one: the agent reads frame grids to understand the original, generates footage with the models it supports (Seedance, PixVerse, MiniMax, Wan and others), and renders captions and motion graphics in HTML. It doesn't ask how the original was made. A live-action source goes through the same pipeline; it won't tell you how many cameras were used or how it was lit. What AI video it can match depends on the models it supports: no Kling or Veo, no dedicated avatar or 3D path, and no AI music (you bring your own). It's strongest on talking-head, podcast and interview videos that follow a script, and weaker on music-driven edits, product motion graphics and cinematic shorts. rea-video doesn't render a video. It works out shot by shot whether something was filmed, AI-generated or built in code, then gives a shooting plan, prompts or a code approach for each. For a quick lookalike, Hypit is faster. To understand how the original was made and remake it cheaply, use rea-video. They work fine together.
Do I need a video-capable model? What does it cost? No. Tools-only mode is offline and free, and already accurate on original files. For recompressed platform downloads, add a video-capable model (Gemini or Doubao both work) or use an agent that can see images; you pay whatever that service charges. Automatic video generation (capsule-cinema) does a free dry run first and only calls paid models after you confirm.
Can it remake the whole video automatically? Partly. With [capsule-cinema](https://github.com/JuneYaooo/capsule-cinema) installed, AI shots are generated and placed back on the original timeline automatically. You film the live shots from the shooting plan, and the agent writes the code shots as a Remotion project. See [docs/replicate.md](docs/replicate.md).
What is VIDEO.md, and why does rea-video write one? Every skill has a `SKILL.md`; every video gets a `VIDEO.md`. It is an open format for video breakdowns, made so that models read only what a question needs. A full breakdown runs to hundreds of thousands of tokens; VIDEO.md lays it out in levels: a card of a few hundred tokens, an overview and map, a timeline with one line per shot, then one file per shot. Every file states its size, and what is seen on screen is kept apart from what the tools infer. rea-video writes one into every output folder (`out/ref/VIDEO.md`), and its agent skill reads it instead of the raw data. Other agents and tools can read it without knowing rea-video: `pip install videomd`, then `videomd check out/ref`. The spec and guides are at [videomd.github.io/videomd](https://videomd.github.io/videomd/).
Can I just repost someone else's video? No. rea-video is for learning a video's structure, pacing and techniques, then remaking it with material you have the rights to. Don't reuse other people's footage, music, characters or likeness. Follow platform rules and local AI-content labeling requirements when you publish.
